basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old tech enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software engineer, and by night, I'm usually tinkering with tech decks or binge-watching 'WarriorTV.' I have a keen interest in stock markets and enjoy discussing investment strategies on 'BB_Stock.' I dislike overly salty foods and early mornings, so you'll usually find me online after 8 PM. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner and we enjoy exploring the outdoors together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software industry for over a decade. My interest in technology extends beyond my job, as I enjoy learning about new gadgets and programming languages through online courses and tech forums.
